targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', finished_at) AS time, result AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Trust of the newest versions

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.trust AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM version_trust t JOIN versions v ON v.id = t.version_id JOIN addons a ON a.id = v.addon_id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.id = (SELECT id FROM versions WHERE addon_id = a.id ORDER BY published_at DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY 1

panels.description: The trust level of each listed addon's newest version: how much of the catalog is flagged or blocked. Ignores the time range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', finished_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)) AS "median", max(extract(epoch FROM finished_at - started_at)) AS "slowest" FROM scans WHERE $__timeFilter(finished_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top scanner rules

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.rule AS "Rule", f.severity AS "Severity", count(*) AS "Findings", count(DISTINCT s.version_id) AS "Versions" FROM findings f JOIN scans s ON s.id = f.scan_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.finished_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: Rules that fired most in the time range. A rule that fires on many versions may be too strict.

panels.title: Time to verification

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', w.created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY extract(epoch FROM w.created_at - v.published_at) / 3600) AS "median hours", count(*) AS "verified" FROM verifications w JOIN versions v ON v.id = w.version_id WHERE $__timeFilter(w.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Per week: versions an admin verified, and the median hours from the release to the verification.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM reports WHERE status = 'open'
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM verification_requests WHERE status = 'open'

panels.title: Oldest open item

targets.rawSql: SELECT extract(epoch FROM now() - min(created_at)) AS value FROM (SELECT created_at FROM reports WHERE status = 'open' UNION ALL SELECT created_at FROM verification_requests WHERE status = 'open') q

panels.description: Age of the oldest open report or verification request: orange after one day, red after three.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'report' AS "Kind", r.target_type || ' ' || r.target_id AS "Target", r.reason AS "Reason", r.created_at AS "Since" FROM reports r WHERE r.status = 'open' UNION ALL SELECT 'verification', a.slug::text, '', q.created_at FROM verification_requests q JOIN addons a ON a.id = q.addon_id WHERE q.status = 'open' ORDER BY 4 LIMIT 50

panels.title: Comments per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_id IS NULL) AS "comments", count(*) FILTER (WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL) AS "replies", count(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS "deleted" FROM addon_comments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Addon comments and replies by the day they were written. Issues live on GitHub and are not counted here.

panels.title: New creators and addons per week

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, count(*) AS "addons", count(*) FILTER (WHERE first) AS "creators" FROM (SELECT created_at, owner_id IS NOT NULL AND created_at = min(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY owner_id) AS first FROM addons) q WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Addons added per week, and owners whose first addon it was. Deleted addons still count.

panels.title: Packs built per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', coalesce(built_at, requested_at)) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM pack_files WHERE $__timeFilter(requested_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Pack zips by build day and state. A zip whose file was deleted is gone from here too, so older days count low.

panels.title: Most downloaded packs

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.id AS "Pack", nullif(p.name, '') AS "Name", count(DISTINCT pv.version_id) AS "Addons", d.downloads AS "Downloads" FROM (SELECT target_id, sum(count) AS downloads FROM download_counts WHERE source = 'pack' AND $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1) d JOIN packs p ON p.id = d.target_id LEFT JOIN pack_versions pv ON pv.pack_id = p.id GROUP BY 1, 2, 4 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Packs by downloads in the time range. The link is left out on purpose.
